Structure: { [architect_display_name]: CumulativeChartView } Record keys MUST match timeseries_chart.json.adv.categories strings exactly (architect display names as produced by nna_aua_by_advisor.parquet). CumulativeChartView: { description: string, categories: string[], -- top 8 clients by latest-day AUA in format "{relationship_name} ({relationship_id})" (fallback to relationship_id if name absent) plus "Other" if remainder > 0 data: [{ date: YYYY-MM-DD, [client_key]: aua_dollars, ... }] } Source: gold/client_performance.parquet (total_aua) joined with gold/client_dimension.parquet (relationship_name, primary_architect). Client Lifecycle Analysis: NMNC/NMEC AUM over time at multiple grains. NMNC/NMEC classification: trailing-12-month vintage rule. months_since_first = (row_date - cdim.first_seen_date).days / 30.44 NMNC if months_since_first <= 12, else NMEC. Same rule as timeseries_chart.json.aua view (verified in build_timeseries_chart()).
Sub-keys: total: CumulativeChartView -- firm-wide NMNC/NMEC AUM dollars over time { description, categories: ["NMNC","NMEC"], data: [{date, NMNC, NMEC}] }
geo_drill: Record<state, CumulativeChartView> Keys are state abbreviations (e.g. "TX", "CA") and MUST match timeseries_chart.json.geo.categories strings exactly. Each view: 2-series NMNC/NMEC AUM for that state's clients (filtered by cdim.primary_state -- current snapshot).
adv_drill: Record<architect_display_name, CumulativeChartView> Keys MUST match timeseries_chart.json.adv.categories strings exactly (architect display names, excluding "Other"). Each view: 2-series NMNC/NMEC AUM for that architect's clients (filtered by cdim.primary_architect -- current snapshot).
geo_city_drill: Record<state, Record<city, CumulativeChartView>> Optional. Present when cdim.primary_city is populated. State keys match geo.categories. City keys are city display names (top MAX_CLA_CITIES=9 by latest-day AUA per state). Each view: 2-series NMNC/NMEC AUM for that city's clients. Source: cdim.primary_city (CTO scope correction, ADVI-004 task order A2.0). Confirmed available in gold/client_dimension.parquet lines 267-268 of 04_build_client_dimension.py.

Monthly AUA change decomposed into market appreciation and NNA. Cumulative NNA, inflows, outflows by US state. Flat key format. { description, categories: [states], data: [{ date, [state], [state]_inflow, [state]_outflow }] }
Cumulative NNA, inflows, outflows by architect. Flat key format. { description, categories: [architects], data: [{ date, [arch], [arch]_inflow, [arch]_outflow }] }
Optional. Per-city NNA within top states. { [state]: { categories: [cities], data: [{ date, [city], [city]_inflow, [city]_outflow }] } }

Optional. Asset class AUA breakdown from holdings_lots snapshots (monthly). { description: string, categories: ["Equities","Fixed Income","Real Estate","Alternatives","Cash","Other"], data: [{ period: "YYYY-MM", segments: [{ label: string, value: float }] }] } Source: gold/holdings_lots/YYYY-MM-DD.parquet (one per month-end). Classification: name-pattern heuristic on asset_name (inline in publisher Lambda). 6 categories: Equities (US+Intl), Fixed Income, Real Estate (split from Alternatives), Alternatives, Cash, Other. Present only when holdings_lots snapshots exist in S3.

page_pipeline.mdpf_global_timeseries: Producer: data/mdpf/scripts/backfill/build_aggregate_aua_timeseries.py (rollup of platinum/mdpf/aggregate_aua/{date}.json partitions). Served (opal-data-portal-v2): json/mdpf/global/aggregate-aua-timeseries.json + json/mdpf/{firm_id}/...; consumed by getMdpfAggregateAUATimeSeriesByFirm() (portal-proxy.ts) on the ModelPortfolios Global + per-firm AUA trend. Columnar shape: dates[], aggregate {opal_aggregate_aua, model_aua, non_model_aua}, per-firm {model_aua, non_model_aua, partner_custody_total}, by_model {model_value, account_count, cohort_class}. SHAPE CHANGE — YANG_SITTW.TO-1 (2026-06-16, Andrew-direct): the sma_aua (1c) term is REMOVED from the aggregate + per-firm slices and FOLDED into non_model_aua (1b' = Schwab_total - 1a, SMA-inclusive). It carried a fabricated non-zero interpolated estimate pre-launch (real SMA == $0 until ~2026-05-20); because 1b is a plug, the fold is never-widen-safe (opal_aggregate_aua + model_aua + the combined non-model band all UNCHANGED at every date; verified before/after = $0 movement on global/49financial/ inflection). REAL SMA detail survives in the by_model cohort_class='sma' sleeves (honestly null pre-launch; already filtered out of the model stack by the FE). FE CONSUMER NOTE: ModelPortfolios.tsx folds non_model_aua + sma_aua via `?? 0` / lastNonNull(undefined)->0, so dropping sma_aua is BACKWARD-COMPATIBLE (renders identical); the FE leg (RD/DE) then removes the now-redundant `+ sma_aua` + makes MdpfPerFirmTimeSeries.sma_aua optional/removed. CONSUMER WARNING (molecule 2026-06-16): SMA is now represented in TWO places -- folded into non_model_aua (1b') AND retained in the by_model cohort_class='sma' sleeves (opal_div_sma, opal_growth_sma; real detail, honestly null pre-launch). A consumer MUST NOT sum by_model ALL-classes WITH non_model_aua -- that double-counts the SMA. Read the model stack as by_model cohort_class='model' only (the live FE filters 'sma'), and read the non-model band as non_model_aua alone. The pre-change invariant `sum(by_model all) + non_model_aua == total` no longer holds; the correct identity is `sum(by_model where class='model') + non_model_aua == opal_aggregate_aua` (= model_aua + 1b'). CONSUMER WARNING (DE /molecule fbfdbe9d, 2026-06-26): opal_aggregate_aua is REQUIRED on the GLOBAL slice -- it is now a load-bearing FE consumer contract. ModelPortfolios' since-inception deep-tail (<2026-01-16) Non-Model band derives `opal_aggregate_aua[i] - model_aua[i]` (the .031 reconcile). If a future build_aggregate_aua_timeseries change DROPS or RENAMES opal_aggregate_aua on the global slice, the memo degrades SILENTLY (optional-chained -> empty map -> falls back to the old non_model_assets band = the +2.9% deep-tail OVERSHOOT returns, no error/crash). Do NOT remove opal_aggregate_aua from the global slice.

bd_gold_inputs.note: BD gold scripts are stored in S3 at s3://opal-data-bd/code/gold/ and are NOT in the local repository. The bd-gold-layer-runner EC2 syncs scripts from that S3 path at boot (run-gold-layer.sh:62). The scripts below are inferred from the parquet key patterns the publisher Lambdas read. Script names follow the convention observed in the legacy bd-gold-layer Lambda (01_build_canonical_timeline.py, etc.) but the current runner uses a newer set of scripts producing the parquets documented here.

gold_script.name: (produces) gold/client_performance.parquet
gold_script.description: Per-relationship daily cumulative AUA, aua_taxable, aua_tax_deferred, aua_tax_exempt, cum_inflows, cum_outflows, nna, num_accounts, num_positions, pct_priced. Primary performance grain consumed by bd-portal-publisher for all AUA/NNA calculations.

gold_script.name: (produces) gold/views/architect_attribution.parquet
gold_script.description: Per-funded-account architect attribution via T0-T16 deterministic decision tree. Columns: account_id, relationship_id, resolved_architect, tier, original_architect, original_implementor. 19 true architects computed dynamically (AUA >= $5M, rels >= 5, active 12M, not 49F/Unassigned). Produced by 08b_build_architect_attribution.py. ~98.3% AUA resolved, ~1.7% Unresolved residual.

gold_script.name: (produces) gold/views/rel_architect_lookup.parquet
gold_script.description: Per-relationship attributed architect assignment: relationship_id, architect. Modal resolved_architect per relationship from architect_attribution.parquet. Contains exactly 19 true architect names + "Unresolved". No 49F House, no Unassigned. Produced by 08b (replaced former production by 08). Consumed by 08, 09, 10.

gold_script.name: (produces) gold/views/nna_aua_by_advisor.parquet
gold_script.description: Per-architect daily AUA/flows aggregation: date, architect, total_aua, aua_taxable, aua_tax_deferred, aua_tax_exempt, cum_inflows, cum_outflows, nna, num_relationships, num_accounts. Drives ADV view in timeseries_chart.json, architect_leaderboard.json, and PartnerAnalyticsResponse.views.adv. Architect assignment sourced from rel_architect_lookup.parquet (written by 08b).

gold_script.name: (produces) gold/views/nna_aua_by_geography.parquet
gold_script.description: Per-state/country daily AUA aggregation: date, state, country, total_aua, cum_inflows, cum_outflows, nna, num_relationships, num_accounts. Drives GEO view in timeseries_chart.json, aua_by_state.json snapshot, and PartnerAnalyticsResponse.views.geo.

gold_script.name: (produces) gold/views/nna_aua_by_geography_city.parquet
gold_script.description: Per-city daily AUA aggregation: date, state, city, total_aua, cum_inflows, cum_outflows, nna, num_relationships. Drives geo_drill sub-view in timeseries_chart.json (optional — gracefully skipped if absent). Maximum 9 cities per state in output.

gold_script.name: (produces) gold/client_dimension.parquet
gold_script.description: Per-relationship static metadata: relationship_id, relationship_name, first_seen_date, primary_architect, primary_implementor, primary_state, primary_country, total_accounts, active_accounts, has_taxable, has_tax_deferred, has_tax_exempt. Used for new-client classification (first_seen_date), PartnerAnalyticsResponse client counts, and engagement/tenure metrics.

gold_script.name: (produces) gold/accounts_dimension_latest.parquet
gold_script.description: Per-account latest metadata: account_id, relationship_id, account_name, architect, implementor, local_relationship, tax_status, qualified_flag, client_state, client_country, account_type, account_is_open, consultant, additional_advisor. Architect field normalized: "Olivia Shin" -> "Liv Shin". consultant and additional_advisor carried from silver transactions (used by 08b T11-T15). Used for filters/dimensions.json and snapshot snapshots (region, account_type).

gold_script.name: (produces) gold/views/client_tax_liability.parquet
gold_script.description: Per-relationship tax lot exposure from holdings data: relationship_id, account_id, tax_status, qualified_flag, asset_name, ticker, purchase_year, total_units, total_cost_basis, total_market_value, total_accrued_gain, short_term_cost_basis, short_term_market_value, short_term_gain, long_term_cost_basis, long_term_market_value, long_term_gain, num_open_lots.
